Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1150404' via compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id and compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
